nodes.name: Walsh Crawlspace & Structural Repair LLC
nodes.description:
Walsh Crawlspace & Structural Repair LLC, located in Charlotte, NC, specializes in crawl space and foundation repair, waterproofing, and real estate inspections. They offer comprehensive services including moisture control, dehumidifier installation, and annual maintenance plans to ensure homes remain structurally sound and comfortable.

The company emphasizes the importance of addressing crawl space issues early to improve indoor air quality and protect property investments. Their licensed professionals provide thorough inspections and tailored repair plans, aiming for reliable service and customer satisfaction.
